Hi Olga,

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. Greenline is excited to get the kickoff on the calendar so we can align owners and get security/tech artifacts ready before the implementation sprint.

High-level asks from our side:
- 60–75 minute kickoff with: intro/roles (15), success/metrics & timelines (10), technical constraints & networking (20), immediate next steps + MAP (15).
- We prefer mornings CEST the week of Jul 10 or Jul 17. Slots that work for our team: Jul 11 09:00–11:00 CEST, Jul 12 08:00–10:00 CEST, Jul 18 09:00–11:30 CEST.
- Please include a fallback plan if any attendee needs to drop (recording + tech deep-dive follow-up).

Attached is a small timezone poll (timezone-poll.csv) with the names of our stakeholders and their UTC offsets.

Could you propose 2–3 options that work for the Redwood ops + CS crew and confirm who will own the run-of-show? Paolo will be the Greenline PM on the call.

Thanks,
Alison Cheng
Director, Product Operations
Greenline Health

  2) Jul 12, 23:00–00:15 PDT (08:00–09:15 CEST)
  3) Jul 18, 00:30–02:00 PDT (09:30–11:00 CEST)
